page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

In terms of connectivity, the ecs.c6t.2xlarge provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. This hardware profile is designed for workloads requiring dedicated compute resources with a lower memory-to-CPU ratio, such as web serving, batch processing, and moderate computational tasks. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention from other tenants on the host.
